capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Nexus, role, whether TAG is invited, expectations summary.

capabilities.name: tag.finance.run_month_end
capabilities.use: Start TAG's month-end run for a finished month when the user asks.

capabilities.name: tag.work.status
capabilities.use: State and outcome of the month-end run and other TAG work.

capabilities.name: tag.expectations.read
capabilities.use: Open obligations and requests for the period.

capabilities.name: tag.policy.reporting.read
capabilities.use: Close checklist, owners, deadlines and thresholds.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.trial_balance.read
capabilities.use: Period status and balances to check readiness.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.period_lock.set
capabilities.use: Request a period lock after sign-off; authorized by the runtime.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route the sign-off package to the close owner.

inputs.name: close checklist with owners, deadlines and dependencies
inputs.source: tag.policy.reporting.read, or agreed with the user and marked proposed

inputs.name: reconciliation, journal entry and statement results
period status
inputs.source: tag.ledger.trial_balance.read period metadata or the user

outputs.name: close plan
outputs.description: Tasks with owner, deadline, dependencies, status and evidence.

outputs.name: close status report
outputs.description: Status, critical path, blockers and unresolved items.

outputs.name: period-lock readiness verdict and request
outputs.description: Evidence per required task; the lock request only after sign-off.

conditions: Starting TAG's month-end run (finance_run_month_end) only at the user's request on the owning side.
Any period lock or reopening needs the close owner's explicit sign-off and runtime authorization.
Sign-off with open exceptions or unreconciled differences needs the close owner's decision.
